ios.desc:
Mighty Timer is the most beautiful way to brew your perfect cup of tea. Available on the Apple Watch, iPhone, and iPad, Mighty Timer knows what temperature, time, and amount of tea you need for the perfect cup.

Features
• Modify any tea profile to brew your perfect cup
• Create custom teas for your taste preference
• Fully control your brew with the Apple Watch
• Choose a light or dark theme; or let Mighty Timer automatically adjust based on your screen brightness
• Customize your app: select between fº and cº, favorite the teas you love the most, pick a quirky alarm sound (martian gun, anyone?)


Happy brewing!

-
Mighty Timer
